info.name: Omnichannel E-Commerce API
info.description:
All endpoints of the Omnichannel platform, grouped as a runnable flow.

**Quick start**
1. Import this collection and one environment (production or local).
2. Select the environment and fill in `adminEmail` / `adminPassword`.
3. Open the collection, click **Run** and run it in order, or run requests one by one.

Tokens and ids (adminToken, token, orderId, sku...) are stored automatically in collection variables.
Requests tagged [ADMIN] use the admin token; everything else uses the customer token.
Folders 4 and 5 use short waits because the order/payment saga is asynchronous (RabbitMQ).
